name: Mohammad Haseeb
bio: Haseeb runs the floor. He sets how every enquiry is handled, from the first call to the day keys change hands, and he is the person clients reach when a deal needs a decision rather than a reply. He pushes the team to quote honest numbers, even when a higher figure would close faster.

name: Talha Shabbir
bio: Talha builds the relationships that keep SWK ahead of launches: developers, banks and investors who call him before a project goes public. If you are putting together a portfolio rather than buying a single unit, he is the one who maps out the sequence and the numbers behind it.

name: Fareed Choudhary
bio: Fareed has walked most of the communities he recommends, and it shows in the questions he asks about commute, service charges and resale before he talks about price. Buyers come to him for a calm, unhurried second opinion on a shortlist.

name: Issaadi Chahrazed
bio: Chahrazed lives in payment plans and handover schedules. She reads the fine print of new launches so clients do not have to, and she is quick to say when a project looks better in the brochure than on the cashflow sheet.

name: Mohd Shahid Khan
bio: Shahid keeps the back office and the systems running, from paperwork and viewings diary to the website you are reading. Most of what clients never have to think about is something he has already handled.
